csm-f38.name: F38 / F50 symmetric tube benders — both ends of the tube bent at once, Ø1-1/2″ and Ø2″
csm-f38.summary: Two bending heads on one bed bend both ends of a tube in the same stroke — towel rails, handles, furniture frames, U-bolts, chair legs and headboards come off the machine finished, at twice the output of a single-head bender. Stacked tools for Ø3/4″, Ø1″, Ø1-1/4″ and Ø1-1/2″.
